desc:
🚙 You went on a trip with your friends, and the goal was to have a fun evening and sleep under the stars...

🏕️ Set up your camp, light a fire, and chat until you feel sleepy...

🌅 You wake up in the morning to find your car has disappeared, and around you are strange traces that don't resemble anything you know.

👁️ They say it's just a myth to scare kids... but what if it's real?

The Qa'ila dwells in the desert, hears your voices, watches your movements, and knows where you are hiding.

🔦 What you do:

You drive the car and follow the clues
Solve the fairy's riddles and uncover her secret
You hide so they can't see you... and you hold your breath if they get close
Escape before it's too late

👥 Play solo or with up to 4 friends
💾 The game saves your progress, so you can continue from where you left off

⚠️ Don't go out at night... and if you hear someone calling your name from afar, don't respond to them...
